claims.citation: New York Herald, 6 May 1866, p. 10, col. 4
claims.verbatim:
Ship Wm F Storer, Bryant, Liverpool March 19, with mdse
and 644 passengers, to C H Marshall & Co. Had five deaths
during the passage (three children and two adults); April 8,
lat 44, lon 39 34[?], was in company with ship America for New
York.

Ship Wm. F. Storer, Bryant, Liverpool, March 19[?], with mdse. and
644 pass. to C. Marshall & Co. Had five deaths during the passage
(three children and two adults; April 8, in lat. 44, long. 39 34, was in
company with ship America for New-York.
